Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the NovaMed team is impressed with the latency and cost profile so far. We ran into an unexpected holdup on our side: procurement needs final supplier onboarding (security attestation + vendor intake) before a PO can be issued, and the compliance team pushed the timeline out by at least a week.

Can Redwood provide a short, time‑boxed credit top‑up to keep the pilot live through the onboarding window? We expect procurement to clear everything no later than May 27. Specifics:
- Current sandbox usage: 23k tokens/day (attached usage report)
- Requested runway: 7 calendar days
- Commitment: rapid PO submission once onboarding completes; contact is Tom Ellis in procurement (cc'd).

If you need an internal escalation or statement from our compliance team, I can pull that into the thread. Appreciate any temporary accommodations — the team is close to expanding scope based on the pilot results.

Best,

- Marissa to approve bridge amount and duration (sales ops)
- Ben to confirm accounting flow and how we record the temporary credit pending PO
- Marissa/Ben to confirm by EOD tomorrow PST so we can apply the credits immediately.

If you can send a short confirmation from Procurement (e.g., a one‑line email committing to submit the PO when onboarding finalizes), that will speed approvals.
